name: Left Or Right Perfect Dress Up

detail.description:
✨Enter the wonderful world of Perfect Dress Up - where every outfit decision becomes fun and creative! Mix and match to complete the perfect outfit by deciding, left or right? Can you become a proud fashionista or just a stain on the catwalk? This is a battle for the fashion road and become winner of the fashion battles 💥

🎀 Game Features:
- Immerse in fashion show for all ages 
- Experience feel like participating in real fashion show 
- Simplicity and fun of the game 
- Variety of clothes co
